title: Agnostic Biosignatures: Expanding the Search for Life in the Solar System
venue_or_source: Annual Review of Earth and Planetary Sciences
verified_claim_relevant_to_this_paper: Reviews biosignatures that do not assume Earth-like molecular or metabolic signatures; general criteria and functions are central.
limitation_for_this_paper: Review framework does not establish self-repair as a unique signal.

title: A robust agnostic molecular biosignature based on machine learning
authors: H. J. Cleaves; G. Hystad; A. Prabhu; M. L. Wong; et al.
verified_claim_relevant_to_this_paper: Reports an ML method using pyrolysis-GC-MS relational patterns; abstract reports about 90% accuracy on studied sample classes.
limitation_for_this_paper: Different modality and dataset; no comparison to our synthetic action-selection benchmark.

title: The Ladder of Life Detection
authors: M. Neveu; L. E. Hays; M. A. Voytek; M. H. New; M. D. Schulte
verified_claim_relevant_to_this_paper: Provides criteria and decision logic for evaluating life-detection measurements under mission constraints.
limitation_for_this_paper: Framework is not an algorithm for adaptive self-repair probing.

title: Is There Such a Thing as a Biosignature?
authors: C. Malaterre; I. L. ten Kate; M. Baque; et al.
verified_claim_relevant_to_this_paper: Reviews ambiguity in biosignature definitions and warns against overstating causal certainty.
limitation_for_this_paper: Conceptual review; does not benchmark RL.

title: Exoplanet Biosignatures: Future Directions
authors: S. I. Walker; A. E. Bains; L. Cronin; et al.
verified_claim_relevant_to_this_paper: Develops a Bayesian approach and highlights uncertainty in contextual attribution of biosignatures.
limitation_for_this_paper: Exoplanet atmospheric inference differs from active local perturbation sensing.

title: Finding Needles in a Moving Haystack: Prioritizing Alerts with Adversarial Reinforcement Learning
authors: L. Tong; A. Laszka; C. Yan; N. Zhang; Y. Vorobeychik
verified_claim_relevant_to_this_paper: Demonstrates adversarial RL in detection/alert prioritization in other application domains.
limitation_for_this_paper: No astrobiology or self-repair result; supports method precedent only.

title: An Analytic Model of Tissue Self-Healing and Its Network Implementation
authors: B. Suki; J. Herrmann; J. H. T. Bates
verified_claim_relevant_to_this_paper: Models self-healing dynamics and shows a network implementation with recovery behavior.
limitation_for_this_paper: Biological tissue model; does not imply that all self-healing is biological.

title: Discreteness Computation and Rules of Life for Self-Organization Dynamics Beyond Equilibrium
verified_claim_relevant_to_this_paper: Discusses non-equilibrium capacity and life-associated generation/renewal of dynamics.
limitation_for_this_paper: Conceptual perspective; not a validated universal detection test.

title: NASA Life Detection Knowledge Base
verified_claim_relevant_to_this_paper: Aggregates evidence and arguments about biosignatures in contextual mission settings.
limitation_for_this_paper: Knowledge resource is not evidence that the proposed algorithm will work.

title: NASA Ladder of Life Detection
verified_claim_relevant_to_this_paper: Provides a discussion framework for life-detection features, their ambiguity, and measurement constraints.
limitation_for_this_paper: Not a definitive checklist and does not certify any single marker.
